measures.name: Public Measure A
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the County of Dubuque, State of Iowa, enter into one or more loan agreements and issue its general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $18,000,000 for the purposes of improving, developing, and expanding county parks, recreational facilities, campgrounds, and public access areas; improving existing trails and developing new trails and trail connections; enhancing outdoor recreation and educational opportunity infrastructure; protecting drinking water sources and improving the water quality of rivers, streams, wetlands, and groundwater; protecting natural areas, wildlife habitat, forests, prairies, lakes, streams and other environmentally sensitive lands; providing natural floodwater storage and flood reduction measures; to be managed by the Dubuque County Conservation Board, with full public disclosure and oversight of all expenditures?

measures.name: Public Measure NC
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall Kirkwood Community College (Merged Area X) in the Counties of Benton, Black Hawk, Buchanan, Cedar, Clinton, Delaware, Dubuque, Iowa, Jackson, Jefferson, Johnson, Jones, Keokuk, Linn, Louisa, Poweshiek, Tama, and Washington, be authorized to renovate, improve, erect, and equip facilities to modernize learning spaces with an emphasis on health sciences, industrial technologies, agricultural sciences, and business and information technology, contract indebtedness therefor, and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not exceeding $88,000,000 for those purposes?

notes: Supervisors elected at-large ('Vote for no more than Two' on all 37 ballot styles; candidate order rotates). Michael Rabagia (Recorder) is printed with no party label. Sample ballot PDFs are not linked from a static page (ArcGIS Hub app looks them up by address); they were fetched directly from the county GIS server using the ballot-style IDs in the county's precinct-split layer. Conservation bond Public Measure A is countywide; Kirkwood measure NC only on ballot 30.2; Washington Township trustee/clerk only on ballot 34.3.
